tax.name: VAT
tax.note: Prices include VAT at 20%. Add a VAT ID in Billing to be invoiced under the reverse charge instead.

strongAuth.title: Approve the payment with your bank
strongAuth.body: Your bank asks you to approve this payment of {amount} to {company} in its app (3-D Secure). No card details are entered here.
strongAuth.rule: Strong customer authentication (PSD2) on card payments of €30 or more. Later automatic charges are merchant-initiated and exempt.

recurring.title: Authorise automatic top-ups
recurring.body: You authorise {company} to charge your card {amount} without asking each time, whenever your balance drops below your threshold, up to your monthly cap. You approve the first charge with your bank; later ones are merchant-initiated. Withdraw this at any time in Top-ups.

autoRenewal.title: Your plan renews automatically
autoRenewal.body: {plan} renews every month on {date} at {price} including VAT until you cancel. Cancel any time in Plan, effective at the end of the period. We'll tell you at least 30 days before any price change.
